rights.beneficiary: Any lawful holder, including a secondary holder, who satisfies objective onboarding and required screening for verified issued NUSD

timing.starts: Receipt of complete valid request; no discretionary acceptance delay
timing.banking_calendar: Monday-Friday excluding US Federal Reserve banking holidays
timing.bank_receipt: Receiving-bank posting time varies and must be disclosed separately

fees.holder_network_fees: Separately disclosed before authorization; no token transaction is presently available
fees.receiving_bank_fees: May be charged independently by the holder bank; not a Numina deduction

limits.maximum: Available verified holder balance; no routine monetary daily/monthly cap proposed
limits.fractional_remainder: Retained without expiry; final account closure remainder rounded up to one USD cent at Numina expense after identity verification
eligibility: Verified legal holder and token/network identity
Required identity, sanctions and source-of-funds checks
Eligible jurisdiction and same-name supported USD bank account
No duplicate, encumbered or already-redeemed balance
permitted_holds: Unresolved identity, fraud, sanctions or ownership dispute

reserves.minimum_coverage: Segregated eligible external USD reserves cover outstanding NUSD including redemption-locked tokens, plus unpaid USD claims for burned tokens not otherwise counted; no claim counted twice
excluded: Internally assigned treasury entries without external asset evidence
Numina-issued NUSD as its own backing
reserves.reporting_proposal: Daily reconciliation; public monthly supply, reserve composition, custodian and independent assurance disclosures; no reports verified
permitted_assets_proposal: Eligible USD demand deposits with an insured depository institution
US Treasury obligations with remaining maturity of no more than 93 days; subject to applicable issuer and custody rules

activation_requirements: Eligible identified issuer and applicable authorizations
Documented Treasury asset ownership, segregation, custody, liquidity and reconciliation
Effective signed holder terms and supported jurisdictions/banking rails
Verified Numina chain and deployed token identity with security review
Independently tested redemption funding, failure recovery and payout controls
Verified token precision and bank settlement rules supporting USD-cent amounts
